course.title: Unit 2 My feelings-Part B--【例句】
course.description: Part B（How can we understand each other better?）

sentences.content: What's the matter, John?
sentences.english: What's the matter , John ?

sentences.content: You look worried.
sentences.english: You look worried

sentences.content: It's about our project.
sentences.english: It's about our project

sentences.content: Mike and I want to do different things.
sentences.english: Mike and I want to do different things

sentences.content: I see. It's important to listen to each other.
sentences.english: I see . It's important to listen to each other
sentences.chinese: 我明白了。倾听彼此很重要。

sentences.content: Yes, Miss White.
sentences.english: Yes , Miss White

sentences.content: I need to talk to Mike.
sentences.english: I need to talk to Mike

sentences.content: But I'm afraid he's angry with me.
sentences.english: But I'm afraid he's angry with me
sentences.chinese: 但我担心他在生我的气。

sentences.content: Look, here he comes.
sentences.english: Look , here he comes

wordDetails.definition: come（第三人称单数现在时）: 来

sentences.content: You can talk to him now.
sentences.english: You can talk to him now
sentences.chinese: 你现在可以和他谈谈了。

sentences.content: John, I'm sorry.
sentences.english: John , I'm sorry

sentences.content: Let's do both projects!
sentences.english: Let's do both projects !

sentences.content: Chen Jie can work with us.
sentences.english: Chen Jie can work with us
sentences.chinese: 陈杰可以和我们一起工作。

sentences.content: That's great!
sentences.english: That's great !

sentences.content: What's the matter, Oliver?
sentences.english: What's the matter , Oliver ?

sentences.content: You look sad.
sentences.english: You look sad

sentences.content: I want to sing, but I'm not good at it.
sentences.english: I want to sing , but I'm not good at it

sentences.content: Good idea! Thanks.
sentences.english: Good idea ! Thanks

sentences.content: We don't agree with each other.
sentences.english: We don't agree with each other

sentences.content: You can talk to your parents.
sentences.english: You can talk to your parents

sentences.content: You can ask your teacher for help.
sentences.english: You can ask your teacher for help
sentences.chinese: 你可以向你的老师寻求帮助。

sentences.content: You need to listen to your friends.
sentences.english: You need to listen to your friends
sentences.chinese: 你需要倾听朋友的意见。

sentences.content: You can share ideas and help each other.
sentences.english: You can share ideas and help each other
sentences.chinese: 你们可以分享想法并互相帮助。

sentences.content: Our project is so hard
sentences.english: Our project is so hard

sentences.content: We can ask Miss White for help.
sentences.english: We can ask Miss White for help
sentences.chinese: 我们可以向White小姐寻求帮助。

sentences.content: I am happy at school.
sentences.english: I am happy at school

sentences.content: I have many friends.
sentences.english: I have many friends

sentences.content: I play with them in the playground, and we share ideas in class.
sentences.english: I play with them in the playground , and we share ideas in class
sentences.chinese: 我在操场上和他们一起玩耍，在课堂上我们分享想法。

sentences.content: We laugh and study together all day.
sentences.english: We laugh and study together all day
sentences.chinese: 我们整天一起欢笑、一起学习。

sentences.content: I enjoy school.
sentences.english: I enjoy school

sentences.content: But my family just moved to a new home.
sentences.english: But my family just moved to a new home

sentences.content: I have no friends there. I feel sad.
sentences.english: I have no friends there . I feel sad
sentences.chinese: 我在那里没有朋友。我感到难过。

sentences.content: I don't want to tell my parents.
sentences.english: I don't want to tell my parents

sentences.content: I don't want them to feel bad.
sentences.english: I don't want them to feel bad
sentences.chinese: 我不想让他们感到难过。

sentences.content: What can I do?
sentences.english: What can I do ?

sentences.content: Can you help me?
sentences.english: Can you help me ?
